blocks.prompt: 13 Find the number of arrangements of 3 books on English and 5 books on Urdu for placing them on a shelf such that the books on the same subject are together.
blocks.explanation:
3 English aur 5 Urdu ki kitaabein hain, aur ek mazmoon (subject) ki kitaabein ikatthi rehni chahiye: saari English ek jagah, saari Urdu ek jagah.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: har subject ka ek block; pehle 2 blocks ki tarteeb, phir har block ke andar kitaabon ki tarteeb, aur sab multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 3 alag English kitaabein, 5 alag Urdu kitaabein.
Humein find karna hai: woh tarteebein jin mein ek subject ki kitaabein saath hon.
Tareeqa: Block method: blocks ki tarteeb \(\times\) har block ke andar ki tarteeb. Jab "saath" ki shart ho to block method sab se seedha raasta hai.

2 blocks ki tarteeb
\[2! = 2\]
Kyun: Shelf par ya to English block pehle aur Urdu baad mein, ya Urdu pehle aur English baad mein. Do cheezon ki tarteeb \(2!\).
Dhyan dein: Yeh \(2!\) bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai; log sirf \(3! \times 5! = 720\) likh dete hain.

Blocks ke andar tarteeb
\[\text{English: } 3! = 6\]
\[\text{Urdu: } 5! = 120\]
Kyun: Block ke andar ek subject ki kitaabein aapas mein jagah badal sakti hain; har kitaab alag hai, is liye har tabdeeli nayi tarteeb hai.

Multiply karein
\[2! \times 3! \times 5! = 2 \times 6 \times 120\]
\[= 1440\]
Kyun: Blocks ki har tarteeb andar ki har tarteeb ke saath ban sakti hai, is liye fundamental principle of counting se multiply.

Tasdeeq
English pehle: \(3! \times 5! = 720\). Urdu pehle: \(5! \times 3! = 720\).
\[720 + 720 = 1440 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Blocks ki do tarteebein do alag cases hain ("ya" wali baat), is liye inhein jama kiya; jawab wohi aaya.
